RefreshCookie.name: refreshToken
RefreshCookie.description: Opaque rotating refresh token; fixed expiry 30 days after login. HttpOnly; Secure; SameSite=Lax; Path=/api/v1/auth. Refresh accepts only this cookie, never JSON. Rotate on use without extending expiry. Reuse/expiry/revocation returns 401 and revokes the family. Logout revokes the session and clears the cookie.
